ios.desc:
Track time with beautiful countdown widgets on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Get the results you want by adding beautiful ALWAYS ON motivational countdowns to the device you use every day.

On your wrist? On your Mac? Pretty Progress works there, too. Our objective is to support you achieve your goals.

We beautifully track your goals so you don’t have to. What better place to remind yourself of the things that matter than the devices you use every day?

Your life goals, your health routines, your personal habits, when your newborn arrives, the deadline of your PhD or your mother’s birthday…

No matter what your goal is. Pretty Progress gives you beautiful countdowns with widgets to customize and track them all:

- Count up & down towards a specific date or with a timer
- Create recurrent events and count the days periodically
- Synchronize and import Apple Calendar events and Reminders
- Show the percentage of completion, how much time is left or how much time has past (time since). In years, months, weeks, days... or a combination of them
- Beautiful and unique designs. 6 different templates to customize and add to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, Stand By (iOS 17), and Watch complications
- Customize colors, icons, layout, fonts, size... and every little aspect of the countdown at any time. Create your own personal Home Screen and Watch Face
- A dashboard to visualize all the timers and day counters created and understand your deadlines, goals, achievements, or recurrent tasks
- Notifications: 1 week and 1 day before, and at the end of your countdown, and every day, week, month or year after your habit streak
- A library to get inspired and create widgets easily
- 3 different sizes for the Home Screen widgets: small, medium, and large
- All Lock Screen widgets localizations available
- All complication sizes for Watch Faces supported
- Dark mode support
- iCloud synchronization. Sync your countdowns on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac (Silicon) automatically
- Family sharing enabled for the PRO purchase

WHAT CAN YOU TRACK?
- Health routines
- Personal habits progress
- Countdown to Christmas
- Days until your mother's birthday
- Countdown to your next holidays
- Days until your project release deadline
- Days left until your next trip
- Percentage of your gym routine complete
- Days left until your wedding anniversary
- Days until retirement
- Days until your financial independence
- Percentage of the year, month, week...
- Days left until you
